summary: REQ-4 is not met because Community Voting page contains additional content beyond the required single bold placeholder message. Other requirements (unified Market Intel + AI Sentiment page, passcode gating behavior, and theme standardization) appear partially/likely addressed based on the diff summary, but the diff is truncated for key files so full verification is limited. Several unrequested changes/files were added (migration module, project_state.json) and an immutable hook file was modified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the Community Voting page to remove all existing voting/proposals UI and replace it with a single bold placeholder message: "Voting session will coming soon".
missing_requirements.reason: The page includes additional user-facing content (a paragraph) so it is not "only the bold text" as required by the acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: Added additional explanatory paragraph text on the Community Voting page (beyond the required single bold placeholder message).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-4 explicitly requires the /community-voting page display only the bold text and no other voting content or UI; the diff adds extra copy.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a backend migration module and wired it into the main actor via a `with migration = Migration.run` clause.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not request adding a migration system/module; it only constrains the backend to remain a single Motoko actor.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/updated `project_state.json` containing meta project state and feature inventory.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; appears to be tooling/meta documentation rather than a requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: Modified an immutable frontend hook file (`useInternetIdentity.ts`).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest constraints explicitly list `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts` as immutable (must not be edited).
